column3: CIS for VSDC
Product brochure
Product warranty statement
User manual
Installation guide
Programming and configuration manual
The CIS shall be able to configure the MRC of each connected device as prescribed in Article 3 of technical specification of CIS for VSDC
CIS shall generates all type of receipt with detailed information including goods and/or service as specified in Article 4 of technical specification of CIS for VSDC
The CIS shall be able to produce Normal Sale (NS) receipt
The CIS shall be able to produce Normal Refund (NR) receipt
The CIS shall be able to produce Copy (CS/CR) of an existing normal receipt/refund
The CIS shall be able to produce Training (TS, TR) when function enabled
The CIS shall be able to produce Proforma (PS)
All necessary communication protocol to connect CIS to VSDC
The CIS shall request receipt signature to VSDC by sending receipt data in prescribed format
The CIS shall Receive response data from VSDC and add this information to receipt structure as described in CIS specification
The CIS shall not produce the receipt in case of error or failure from VSDC
CIS shall print out the receipt for every transaction as specified in CIS specification
CIS can print invoice on different format (A4, A5, Paper roll, etc..) as long as it has all required information
CIS shall be able to perform a transaction and display an operation of minimum 13 digits inclusive of 2 decimal places
The CIS shall be able to print the Daily X report and Z report as specified in article 7,18 and 19 of technical specification of CIS for VSDC
CIS software must have a version number which can be verified and printed on each receipt

The CIS must not be able to issue receipt of any type if not connected to VSDC unit which is functioning under normal circumstances with the same TIN (must indicate error if VSDC is disconnected or malfunctioned)
The CIS shall be able to manage and send the stock information to VSDC in prescribed format
The CIS shall be able to produce PLU report as described in article 21 of technical specification of CIS for VSDC
The CIS shall be able to produce detailed report of sales, purchases, stock, items and importation
The CIS shall register the means of payment used for transaction (Cash, Credit, Bank Check, Mobile payment, etc…)
The CIS shall not allow the registration of the value of the transaction without identifying the good and/or services, quantity and price
This CIS shall not allow the modification of approved receipt, however the CIS shall allow to make refund with reference to the original erroneous invoice with clear evidence and print it
The CIS shall print only one original for each receipt transaction with all required information as specified in article 7 of technical specification of CIS for VSDC
The CIS shall be able to re-print an existing invoice as COPY with all its requirement specified in technical specification of CIS for VSDC
The printed receipt shall have a QR code as specified in technical specification of CIS for VSDC
The CIS shall print  official RRA logos on each each receipt regardless the type
Receipt Header: the name and the address must contain at least 3 lines
TIN must be written in first block and SDC information before the last block
TIN, Name and Mobile contact number of Client must be included, in Case there is no TIN, Mobile contact must be used
The date, hour, minutes and seconds show when the receipt is issued
CIS shall manage purchase code from sales
CIS shall manage purchase code from purchases
The CIS shall be able to manage price discounts when making receipt
The copy (CS, CR) receipt must contain same sales information as previously printed normal sale (NS) or normal refund (NR) receipt, with clear designation of COPY sign
The training (TS, TR) receipt can contain similar information as normal sale (NS) or normal refund (NR) receipt, with clear designation of TRAINING sign
Operation in training mode must be activated by function different than sales mode
The proforma (PS) receipt can contain similar information as normal sale (NS) receipt, with clear designation of PROFORMA sign

The journal is a document which is issued in the same time with the receipt (of type normal) and which contains the same data as the printed slip (ether paper and electronic form), EJ must be compared with printed slip and must be the same.
The CIS shall be able to configure the tax rates (A,B,C,D) as specified in National tax law
The CIS shall be able to print the tax values with label which indicates taxes used (A,B,C,D)

The CIS shall round values of tax on two decimals.
(<5 - down, >=5 -up)
If tax rate is programmed with value > 0, the tax label and value must be printed on every receipt regardless if sale was including that particular tax rate (B)
If tax rate is = 0, the tax label and value must be printed only when item with this particular tax rate is used (A,C and D)
The CIS shall have a consecutive counter for receipts regardless the type.
The Counters start from integer 1 and increment by 1 according to its transaction
Item count presents number of items shown on the receipt (line by line, excluding voids)
The CIS shall be able to manage the stock for countable items.
The CIS shall be able to print a copy sales from the existing normal receipt as specified in technical specification of CIS for VSDC

Label COPY, TRAINING, PROFORMA has to be placed on the ticket. Moreover, in such a case the following text after the tax calculation and at the bottom of the ticket to be printed: "THIS IS NOT AN OFFICIAL RECEIPT”
The Refund receipt has always to be printed with a negative, (-) minus sign in front of each amount
The Refund receipt must have the reference to which normal receipt number it is made
CIS must able to Consume "Initialization API" using parameters provided (Tin, Bhf_id and Device serial number) as described in RRA VSDC API technical specification document

CIS must able to Consume  Codes api which contains all the codes to use for entire CIS integration, CIS should argonize all those codes based on their categories as described in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
"item codes" must be created automatically based on the choice made during creation of item/service as described in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must consume Item class API/UNSPSC to use for  "Item Classification code" as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must consume Customer API as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must able to save all items/services to RRA as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must able to select items/services from RRA as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must be able to receive notices from RRA Notice API as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must able to receive importation details as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document

column3: CIS must able to update importations status once approved or rejected as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must able to save sales transactions as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must be able to receive purchases as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must be able to update purchases received as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must send stock IN and Stock OUT to RRA  for each item received or sold as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
CIS must send the stock remains after receiving or selling  any item as described  in RRA VSDC API technical specification document
Stock must be affected and sychronized at real time for  approved importations, received purchases and sales level
The CIS shall be able to display and handle errors received from VSDC
